exporterCandidates.name: glTF Transform core
exporterCandidates.decision: ADOPTED_BUILD_ONLY: core 4.5.1 with property-graph 4.1.0; no renderer, DOM shim, textures or native dependency required. Pinned tarball/source/notices retained.

exporterCandidates.name: Three.js GLTFExporter
exporterCandidates.decision: NOT_ADOPTED: mature standard exporter, but this bounded asset producer does not need the scene engine dependency or Node export shims. Does not constrain S13's renderer choice.

exporterCandidates.name: pygltflib
exporterCandidates.decision: NOT_ADOPTED: useful glTF/GLB serializer but manual buffer assembly and Python dependencies add no benefit over NodeIO for this pack. No package installed.

rea.reason: No claim relies on closed package behavior, binary decompilation or donor runtime. The complete pinned exporter source was available and inspected; skill explicitly routes ordinary source analysis away from REA.
